nodes.label: Letterbox-Aware Detection Overlay Alignment
nodes.source_file: C:\AI-Based Driver Safety and Assistance System(ADAS)\SentryEye platform official\.lovable\plan\video-detection-box-alignment-report-smarter-conversion-rest-2026-08-06.md
nodes.rationale: Boxes appeared beside the eye because the overlay mapped detections onto the whole video element including black letterbox bars; the fix derives the real picture rect from videoWidth/videoHeight vs clientWidth/clientHeight (object-contain math) and draws only inside it, so boxes land correctly at any window size in landscape and portrait.

nodes.label: Visitor-Mode Inline Driver Report
nodes.source_file: C:\AI-Based Driver Safety and Assistance System(ADAS)\SentryEye platform official\.lovable\plan\video-detection-box-alignment-report-smarter-conversion-rest-2026-08-06.md
nodes.rationale: Report links were only produced for signed-in users because visitor sessions are never persisted; rather than persisting visitor data, the plan renders the same report component from the in-memory session summary so privacy is preserved while the outcome is still visible.

nodes.label: Conditional Video Conversion Skip
nodes.source_file: C:\AI-Based Driver Safety and Assistance System(ADAS)\SentryEye platform official\.lovable\plan\video-detection-box-alignment-report-smarter-conversion-rest-2026-08-06.md
nodes.rationale: Conversion is skipped whenever the browser can natively decode the file; the skip is made explicit in the pipeline UI and the download button is gated on a real converted blob existing, because offering a download for a file that was never produced misleads the user.

nodes.label: Stale Auto-Start Flag on New Analysis
nodes.source_file: C:\AI-Based Driver Safety and Assistance System(ADAS)\SentryEye platform official\.lovable\plan\video-detection-box-alignment-report-smarter-conversion-rest-2026-08-06.md
nodes.rationale: Not root-caused; the reset path clears media element, analysis context and auto-start flag yet the pipeline stays unarmed. Approach is a Playwright reproduction capturing pipeline stage and flags per step before changing code, rather than guessing at the flag.

nodes.label: Microsleep Detection and Wake-Up Alarm
nodes.source_file: C:\AI-Based Driver Safety and Assistance System(ADAS)\SentryEye platform official\.lovable\plan\video-detection-box-alignment-report-smarter-conversion-rest-2026-08-06.md
nodes.rationale: Thresholds of 0.5 s (microsleep) and 1.5 s (critical) move from fixed constants into user settings so they can be tuned per driver; visibility (panel, red flash, alarm, timeline markers, PDF section) is added because an invisible detector cannot be trusted.

nodes.label: Temporal Smoothing of Detection State
nodes.source_file: C:\AI-Based Driver Safety and Assistance System(ADAS)\SentryEye platform official\.lovable\plan\video-detection-box-alignment-report-smarter-conversion-rest-2026-08-06.md
nodes.rationale: Requiring N consecutive frames of the same state before switching removes single-frame flicker such as a 37% eye_closed appearing next to a 61% eye_open.

nodes.label: Per-Eye Left/Right Pairing
nodes.source_file: C:\AI-Based Driver Safety and Assistance System(ADAS)\SentryEye platform official\.lovable\plan\video-detection-box-alignment-report-smarter-conversion-rest-2026-08-06.md
nodes.rationale: Pair left/right eye boxes and require both closed so a partly occluded face does not trigger a false microsleep.

nodes.label: Confidence Gating for Scoring
nodes.source_file: C:\AI-Based Driver Safety and Assistance System(ADAS)\SentryEye platform official\.lovable\plan\video-detection-box-alignment-report-smarter-conversion-rest-2026-08-06.md
nodes.rationale: Low-confidence detections may still be drawn but are ignored for scoring, which cuts most false alerts without hiding what the model saw.

nodes.label: Measure-First, Fix-Smallest-Broken-Layer Principle
nodes.source_file: C:\AI-Based Driver Safety and Assistance System(ADAS)\SentryEye platform official\.lovable\plan\yawning-pipeline-measure-first-then-fix-the-smallest-broken-2026-08-07.md
nodes.rationale: A class-2 detection must survive four gates and nothing records where it dies, so instrumentation comes before any behaviour change; if class 2 never appears above ~0.1 on clear yawning footage the report must state model-level insufficiency rather than applying a software fake-fix.

nodes.label: Class-2 Yawn Probe Instrumentation
nodes.source_file: C:\AI-Based Driver Safety and Assistance System(ADAS)\SentryEye platform official\.lovable\plan\yawning-pipeline-measure-first-then-fix-the-smallest-broken-2026-08-07.md
nodes.rationale: An optional probe callback in postprocess reports the best class-2 score before the threshold branch; when no probe is attached the code path is byte-identical to today, so measurement cannot change behaviour.

nodes.label: Single Global Confidence Gate (cfg.confThreshold)
nodes.source_file: C:\AI-Based Driver Safety and Assistance System(ADAS)\SentryEye platform official\.lovable\plan\yawning-pipeline-measure-first-then-fix-the-smallest-broken-2026-08-07.md
nodes.rationale: One threshold (0.35 desktop, 0.22 mobile recovery preset) filters class 2 with the same number as the eyes; there is currently no per-class threshold, which is why yawns may vanish before the app can see them.

nodes.label: Class-Aware NMS with Cross-Class Dedupe
nodes.source_file: C:\AI-Based Driver Safety and Assistance System(ADAS)\SentryEye platform official\.lovable\plan\yawning-pipeline-measure-first-then-fix-the-smallest-broken-2026-08-07.md
nodes.rationale: NMS runs per class then drops any box overlapping a kept box by IoU > 0.65; a mouth box rarely overlaps an eye that much, but this is the one place class 2 could silently vanish, so it is measured rather than assumed.

nodes.label: Class-Specific yawnCandidateConf Threshold
nodes.source_file: C:\AI-Based Driver Safety and Assistance System(ADAS)\SentryEye platform official\.lovable\plan\yawning-pipeline-measure-first-then-fix-the-smallest-broken-2026-08-07.md
nodes.rationale: A separate lower threshold applied to class 2 only, added only if the measurement justifies it; eye classes keep confThreshold byte for byte, and the confirmed-event bar stays high, reached through temporal evidence rather than by lowering anything globally.

nodes.label: YawnStateMachine (IDLE → CANDIDATE → ACTIVE → END → COOLDOWN)
nodes.source_file: C:\AI-Based Driver Safety and Assistance System(ADAS)\SentryEye platform official\.lovable\plan\yawning-pipeline-measure-first-then-fix-the-smallest-broken-2026-08-07.md
nodes.rationale: Replaces scattered booleans in event-aggregator.ts with an explicit state machine; a micro-yawn that keeps going is upgraded in place so a single physical yawn can never double-count, cooldown suppresses duplicates, and every rejection stores a reason (too_short, no_continuity, low_conf, smile_geometry, cooldown).

nodes.label: Geometry-Based Smile/Laugh Rejection
nodes.source_file: C:\AI-Based Driver Safety and Assistance System(ADAS)\SentryEye platform official\.lovable\plan\yawning-pipeline-measure-first-then-fix-the-smallest-broken-2026-08-07.md
nodes.rationale: normalisedOpening = mouthHeight / faceHeight (face height estimated from same-frame eye geometry) removes camera-distance dependence; a yawn shows vertical growth, plateau and decay while a smile widens horizontally with a short plateau. The trajectory is scored across the candidate window, which is what actually separates a laugh from a yawn. No face-landmark library is added in this pass.

nodes.label: YAWNS/MIN Counted from Confirmed Events
nodes.source_file: C:\AI-Based Driver Safety and Assistance System(ADAS)\SentryEye platform official\.lovable\plan\yawning-pipeline-measure-first-then-fix-the-smallest-broken-2026-08-07.md
nodes.rationale: The rolling-minute counter uses confirmed yawn events, never class-2 frames, and this is verified by test.

nodes.label: Per-Driver Mouth Calibration Phase
nodes.source_file: C:\AI-Based Driver Safety and Assistance System(ADAS)\SentryEye platform official\.lovable\plan\yawning-pipeline-measure-first-then-fix-the-smallest-broken-2026-08-07.md
nodes.rationale: The first seconds of footage learn resting mouth aspect and normalised opening, scaling candidate/event thresholds to that driver; stored alongside the existing eye calibration profile and applied to both live and uploaded runs.

nodes.label: Eye-Path Byte-Identical Regression Guard
nodes.source_file: C:\AI-Based Driver Safety and Assistance System(ADAS)\SentryEye platform official\.lovable\plan\yawning-pipeline-measure-first-then-fix-the-smallest-broken-2026-08-07.md
nodes.rationale: Eye counters for the validation clips must be byte-identical to a pre-change run; this is the concrete proof that scoping the work to the yawn path did not disturb the eye path.

nodes.label: Mobile Live Detection Experience Fix
nodes.source_file: C:\AI-Based Driver Safety and Assistance System(ADAS)\SentryEye platform official\.lovable\plan\إصلاح-تجربة-live-detection-على-الموبايل-2026-08-10.md
nodes.rationale: Live must open as a real camera experience: drawer closes on route change inside the Sidebar component itself (not per-link onClick), portrait preview appears first, no repeated manual calibration wizard, and no flood of wrong boxes after start or model switch. Advanced controls (model download, compatibility, calibration, low-light, diagnostics) move to Advanced settings.

nodes.label: True Portrait Camera Orientation on Mobile
nodes.source_file: C:\AI-Based Driver Safety and Assistance System(ADAS)\SentryEye platform official\.lovable\plan\إصلاح-تجربة-live-detection-على-الموبايل-2026-08-10.md
nodes.rationale: Portrait becomes the phone default; camera constraints are unified between run and preflight, and the actual track dimensions Android granted are read after getUserMedia instead of assuming the 'ideal' values were applied, with per-device persistence.

nodes.label: Silent Auto-Calibration Without Wizard
nodes.source_file: C:\AI-Based Driver Safety and Assistance System(ADAS)\SentryEye platform official\.lovable\plan\إصلاح-تجربة-live-detection-على-الموبايل-2026-08-10.md
nodes.rationale: The repeated wizard is replaced by silent calibration from the first valid seconds of a run (lighting, face size, eye confidence, processing rate); values apply gradually only after a sufficient sample, falling back to safe values on a weak sample, so the driver is never blocked.

nodes.label: Anatomical Filter and Box-Flood Prevention
nodes.source_file: C:\AI-Based Driver Safety and Assistance System(ADAS)\SentryEye platform official\.lovable\plan\إصلاح-تجربة-live-detection-على-الموبايل-2026-08-10.md
nodes.rationale: Preview uses object-cover while the overlay computed object-contain coordinates, so both are unified to one crop/scale/mirror. A post-NMS anatomical filter caps at two separate eyes plus one mouth box; flood detection works across several frames rather than a single >24-box frame, clearing tracker tracks and refusing to draw corrupt results. maxDetections drops from the generic 100 to a single-face-appropriate limit, explicitly without raising IoU.

nodes.label: Structural Compatibility vs Real Model Readiness
nodes.source_file: C:\AI-Based Driver Safety and Assistance System(ADAS)\SentryEye platform official\.lovable\plan\إصلاح-تجربة-live-detection-على-الموبايل-2026-08-10.md
nodes.rationale: Checking file, shape and labels does not prove detection is correct or fast, so a short real-camera-frame check measures latency, box count, stability and confidence distribution after load. On phones the 640 model is barred as the default Live choice and 320 is chosen before opening the camera. WebGPU is tried first and falls back to a fresh WASM session only on a trustworthy failure — phones are never forced onto WASM outright, and if the 320 file itself proves inaccurate after pipeline fixes that is reported as a documented model failure rather than hidden with UI tweaks.

nodes.label: Lovable Git History Preservation Rule
nodes.source_file: C:\AI-Based Driver Safety and Assistance System(ADAS)\SentryEye platform official\AGENTS.md
nodes.rationale: Force-pushing, rebasing, amending or squashing already-pushed commits rewrites history on Lovable's side and would lose the user's project history; commits on the connected branch sync back into the Lovable editor, so the branch must stay working.

nodes.label: Guardian Eye (SentryEye) Product Brief
nodes.source_file: C:\AI-Based Driver Safety and Assistance System(ADAS)\SentryEye platform official\README.md
nodes.rationale: The original brief deliberately forbade code generation until the full architecture (folder structure, backend, frontend, API, DB schema, comms, real-time inference workflow) was designed, because the AI model was already trained and the risk lay in the surrounding system.

nodes.label: SentryEye Remote Inference Service (FastAPI)
nodes.source_file: C:\AI-Based Driver Safety and Assistance System(ADAS)\SentryEye platform official\backend\README.md
nodes.rationale: Exists as an automatic fallback for mid-range Android devices that cannot sustain real-time on-device inference (typically 640px graphs in single-threaded WASM), not as the primary path.

nodes.label: POST /v1/detect Hot Path
nodes.source_file: C:\AI-Based Driver Safety and Assistance System(ADAS)\SentryEye platform official\backend\README.md
nodes.rationale: Takes a raw JPEG body with thresholds passed as x-conf-threshold / x-iou-threshold / x-max-detections / x-imgsz headers to keep the hot path free of multipart parsing; the multipart /v1/detect/upload variant exists only for manual Swagger testing.

nodes.label: Class-ID + Normalized-Box Response Contract
nodes.source_file: C:\AI-Based Driver Safety and Assistance System(ADAS)\SentryEye platform official\backend\README.md
nodes.rationale: The service returns only class ids and normalized [x,y,w,h]; labels and semantic tags (eye_closed, yawn) are resolved client-side from the model registry, so swapping the checkpoint never requires a client change.

nodes.label: Backend Runtime Dependencies
nodes.source_file: C:\AI-Based Driver Safety and Assistance System(ADAS)\SentryEye platform official\backend\requirements.txt
nodes.rationale: fastapi, uvicorn[standard], pillow, numpy, ultralytics>=8.3 and python-multipart — Ultralytics is the inference engine and python-multipart backs only the manual upload endpoint.

nodes.label: TanStack Start File-Based Routing Conventions
nodes.source_file: C:\AI-Based Driver Safety and Assistance System(ADAS)\SentryEye platform official\src\routes\README.md
nodes.rationale: Next.js/Remix conventions (src/pages/, app/layout.tsx) are explicitly banned because the only root layout is __root.tsx; routeTree.gen.ts is generated and must not be hand-edited.

nodes.label: On-Device Browser Inference Privacy Model
nodes.source_file: C:\AI-Based Driver Safety and Assistance System(ADAS)\SentryEye platform official\docs\AI-HANDOFF-REPORT.md
nodes.rationale: All inference runs in a Web Worker on-device so no frame, image or video ever leaves the device; the cloud receives only summarised safety events and finalized shift reports.

nodes.label: Layered Architecture (UI / Logic / Inference / Data)
nodes.source_file: C:\AI-Based Driver Safety and Assistance System(ADAS)\SentryEye platform official\docs\AI-HANDOFF-REPORT.md
nodes.rationale: Hard rule: the UI never talks to ONNX or SQL directly — it talks to hooks, and hooks talk to pure logic plus the provider interface, which keeps the drowsiness/session/fleet logic pure and unit-testable.

nodes.label: Two-Model fp32-Only Invariant
nodes.source_file: C:\AI-Based Driver Safety and Assistance System(ADAS)\SentryEye platform official\docs\AI-HANDOFF-REPORT.md
nodes.rationale: Exactly two models exist — yolo26n-480-fast (default on constrained/mobile) and yolo26n-960-high (gated off devices with <4 GB RAM) — both fp32 on every execution provider, with no fp16 exports and no CPU twins, to keep the accuracy story and the engine matrix tractable. Accuracy comparisons must use closed_eye AP, never aggregate mAP.

nodes.label: WebGPU → Self-Test → WASM Engine Ladder
nodes.source_file: C:\AI-Based Driver Safety and Assistance System(ADAS)\SentryEye platform official\docs\AI-HANDOFF-REPORT.md
nodes.rationale: A watchdog-guarded WebGPU adapter probe is followed by a worker self-test on the created session, with WASM (SIMD + threads) as the always-available floor; every attempt and rejection reason is surfaced in Diagnostics, and the winning engine+model are persisted so the next boot skips re-probing. Phones are never forced onto WASM-only.

nodes.label: Postprocess: Class-Aware NMS and Inverse Letterbox
nodes.source_file: C:\AI-Based Driver Safety and Assistance System(ADAS)\SentryEye platform official\docs\AI-HANDOFF-REPORT.md
nodes.rationale: Per-class confidence floors plus class-aware NMS with cross-class dedupe stop one eye carrying a stack of boxes; inverse-letterbox mapping returns display coordinates and corrupt-output rejection handles known-bad mobile GPU drivers. Supports ultralytics-v8 and rf-detr head formats. NMS IoU must never be raised to compensate for low light — lower the confidence floor and let the tracker decide.

nodes.label: WGSL GPU Letterbox Preprocess
nodes.source_file: C:\AI-Based Driver Safety and Assistance System(ADAS)\SentryEye platform official\docs\AI-HANDOFF-REPORT.md
nodes.rationale: With WebGPU live, a WGSL compute shader performs RGB/NCHW letterbox padding zero-copy on the GPU, avoiding a CPU round-trip per frame.

nodes.label: IoU + EMA Detection Tracker with Time-Based Expiry
nodes.source_file: C:\AI-Based Driver Safety and Assistance System(ADAS)\SentryEye platform official\docs\AI-HANDOFF-REPORT.md
nodes.rationale: Tracks expire by milliseconds (maxMissedMs) rather than frame counts so low FPS does not strand boxes on screen.

nodes.label: Hybrid Router (On-Device ↔ Remote FastAPI)
nodes.source_file: C:\AI-Based Driver Safety and Assistance System(ADAS)\SentryEye platform official\docs\AI-HANDOFF-REPORT.md
nodes.rationale: Routes frames to the remote service when on-device FPS or tracking confidence sag, using sustain and cooldown timers to prevent flapping; off entirely unless a URL is configured.

nodes.label: Micro-Event Aggregator and Event Mapping
nodes.source_file: C:\AI-Based Driver Safety and Assistance System(ADAS)\SentryEye platform official\docs\AI-HANDOFF-REPORT.md
nodes.rationale: Per-frame detections become debounced spells and semantic events (eye_closed_sustained, microsleep, critical_microsleep, yawn, long_yawn, drowsy_yawn, drowsy); event-mapping.ts decides which persist, and UI-only events (yawn_started, alert_cleared) are never stored so recovery cannot inflate event counts.

nodes.label: PERCLOS Sliding-Window Closure Fraction
nodes.source_file: C:\AI-Based Driver Safety and Assistance System(ADAS)\SentryEye platform official\docs\AI-HANDOFF-REPORT.md

nodes.label: MAR-Based Mouth State (Smile vs Yawn)
nodes.source_file: C:\AI-Based Driver Safety and Assistance System(ADAS)\SentryEye platform official\docs\AI-HANDOFF-REPORT.md
nodes.rationale: A mouth-aspect baseline separates smiling and talking from yawning; rejected spells are deliberately retained as tuning evidence rather than discarded.

nodes.label: Detection Quality Scoring and Cues Overlay
nodes.source_file: C:\AI-Based Driver Safety and Assistance System(ADAS)\SentryEye platform official\docs\AI-HANDOFF-REPORT.md
nodes.rationale: Lighting, blur, distance, occlusion, confidence and framerate collapse into a 0–100 score with a dominant reason AND its fix, and the overlay shows where the problem is (framing ellipse, darkness veil, blur vignette) so the driver can act rather than just being told the score.

nodes.label: Personal Calibration with Shared computeCalibration()
nodes.source_file: C:\AI-Based Driver Safety and Assistance System(ADAS)\SentryEye platform official\docs\AI-HANDOFF-REPORT.md
nodes.rationale: Uploaded clips are auto-calibrated from their first seconds through the SAME computeCalibration() used by the live wizard, so live and video runs cannot diverge; profiles sync to user_settings so they follow the driver across devices.

nodes.label: finalize_shift() Security-Definer Function
nodes.source_file: C:\AI-Based Driver Safety and Assistance System(ADAS)\SentryEye platform official\docs\AI-HANDOFF-REPORT.md
nodes.rationale: Computes the report, the driver_daily_stats aggregate and the audit row in one transaction so the client can never influence the numbers; reports are insert-once and drivers have no UPDATE/DELETE path.

nodes.label: Weighted Capped Safety Score
nodes.source_file: C:\AI-Based Driver Safety and Assistance System(ADAS)\SentryEye platform official\docs\AI-HANDOFF-REPORT.md
nodes.rationale: Score = 100 − Σ weightᵢ × min(1, indicatorᵢ / capᵢ) × 100, clamped 0–100, with weights, caps and band thresholds read from the organization's scoring_config; every classification carries the factors[] that produced it so a score is always explainable. Bands: low / moderate / high / critical.

nodes.label: Offline-First Sync State Machine
nodes.source_file: C:\AI-Based Driver Safety and Assistance System(ADAS)\SentryEye platform official\docs\AI-HANDOFF-REPORT.md
nodes.rationale: Shifts, events and reports are written locally first under a stable clientShiftId and move local → pending_sync → syncing → synced | sync_error; uploads go shift → events → report as idempotent upserts so a retry can never create a second report, and a background drainer runs on reconnect.

nodes.label: IndexedDB Model Store with Segmented Downloads
nodes.source_file: C:\AI-Based Driver Safety and Assistance System(ADAS)\SentryEye platform official\docs\AI-HANDOFF-REPORT.md
nodes.rationale: Resumable 4-way parallel segmented downloads with checkpointing, checksum verification, per-model deletion, stop control and orphan purge, so a large model fetch survives a flaky mobile connection.

nodes.label: Published-Tabs-Only Service Worker Policy
nodes.source_file: C:\AI-Based Driver Safety and Assistance System(ADAS)\SentryEye platform official\docs\AI-HANDOFF-REPORT.md
nodes.rationale: The app shell is cached only in published tabs; previews actively unregister stale workers so cached code can never mask a fresh build during development.

nodes.label: RLS + Security-Definer Role Enforcement
nodes.source_file: C:\AI-Based Driver Safety and Assistance System(ADAS)\SentryEye platform official\docs\AI-HANDOFF-REPORT.md
nodes.rationale: Roles live only in user_roles (never on profiles) and are read through security-definer helpers; manager-only server functions are guarded server-side, and <Can>/use-roles are UI convenience only, never the enforcement point. Manager access is clamped by the tg_clamp_fleet_role database trigger rather than in the UI.

nodes.label: Expiring Redacted Diagnostics Share Links
nodes.source_file: C:\AI-Based Driver Safety and Assistance System(ADAS)\SentryEye platform official\docs\AI-HANDOFF-REPORT.md
nodes.rationale: diagnostics-redact.ts strips anything identifying — no images, emails or tokens are ever recorded — and shares expire, so a support bundle can be handed out without leaking driver data.

nodes.label: Replay Buffer and Scrubber
nodes.source_file: C:\AI-Based Driver Safety and Assistance System(ADAS)\SentryEye platform official\docs\AI-HANDOFF-REPORT.md
nodes.rationale: Holds roughly 20 minutes at 10 analysed FPS so a reviewer can scrub back through exactly what the model saw at any moment.

nodes.label: Public Schema Data Model
nodes.source_file: C:\AI-Based Driver Safety and Assistance System(ADAS)\SentryEye platform official\docs\AI-HANDOFF-REPORT.md
nodes.rationale: Tables include profiles, user_roles, organizations, org_members, drivers, shifts, safety_events, shift_reports, driver_daily_stats, manager_notes, sessions, detection_events, benchmark_runs, model_registry, media_assets, diagnostics_shares, notifications, user_settings, audit_log, system_metrics; every table has RLS plus explicit GRANTs.

nodes.label: Desktop vs Mobile/Low-Light Presets
nodes.source_file: C:\AI-Based Driver Safety and Assistance System(ADAS)\SentryEye platform official\docs\AI-HANDOFF-REPORT.md
nodes.rationale: Mobile lowers the confidence floor (0.35 → 0.22, display 0.30), softens tracker smoothing (0.5 → 0.35) and extends max-missed (200 ms → 500 ms), but IoU stays 0.50 and is never relaxed for dim light.

nodes.label: Depth-2 Pipelined Frame Scheduling
nodes.source_file: C:\AI-Based Driver Safety and Assistance System(ADAS)\SentryEye platform official\docs\AI-HANDOFF-REPORT.md
nodes.rationale: Latest-frame-wins ImageBitmap capture queue, duty-cycle adaptive scheduler, capture-resolution ladder (1080p → 900p → 720p) and a motion gate that skips still frames keep latency bounded instead of building a backlog.

nodes.label: Manager Dashboard Reads Aggregates Only
nodes.source_file: C:\AI-Based Driver Safety and Assistance System(ADAS)\SentryEye platform official\docs\AI-HANDOFF-REPORT.md
nodes.rationale: Managers see daily aggregates, never raw events, and detection pages are off-limits to managers via a server-side redirect; realtime refresh uses throttled toasts and an unread badge.

nodes.label: SentryEye System Report (Narrative Companion)
nodes.source_file: C:\AI-Based Driver Safety and Assistance System(ADAS)\SentryEye platform official\docs\SYSTEM-REPORT.md
nodes.rationale: The in-app /docs page is generated from the same constants the runtime uses so its numbers can never drift; this markdown file is the narrative companion to that generated page and to AI-HANDOFF-REPORT.md.

nodes.label: RF-DETR Nano Baseline 384
nodes.source_file: C:\AI-Based Driver Safety and Assistance System(ADAS)\checkpoints\rfdetr-nano\old-1-baseline-384\info.md
nodes.rationale: Fresh RF-DETR Nano pretrained backbone, 50/50 epochs, AdamW (decoder 2e-5 / encoder 1e-6), 4.50h. Self-reported val mAP50 91.80%; no independent test evaluation exists, so the number is explicitly untrusted.

nodes.label: RF-DETR Nano Fine-Tuned 384 (Best Old-Project Accuracy)
nodes.source_file: C:\AI-Based Driver Safety and Assistance System(ADAS)\checkpoints\rfdetr-nano\old-2-finetune-384\info.md
nodes.rationale: Warm-started from the nano baseline, 15 epochs, worst-case augmentation (extreme low-light/IR glare, ±15°). TRUSTED test mAP50 92.36% / P 75.62% / R 94.61% / F1 83.78%, per-class closed_eye 97.10%. Despite the 'nano' name it is a ~10M-param transformer whose 113MB ONNX is ~10x heavier than any YOLO-nano export — not a mobile candidate.

nodes.label: RF-DETR Small Baseline 640
nodes.source_file: C:\AI-Based Driver Safety and Assistance System(ADAS)\checkpoints\rfdetr-small\old-1-baseline-640\info.md
nodes.rationale: 15 epochs, 14.20h, worst-case augmentation; self-reported val mAP50 83.80% only. No weight files were found at the expected path and no independent test evaluation exists.

nodes.label: RF-DETR Small Standard 640
nodes.source_file: C:\AI-Based Driver Safety and Assistance System(ADAS)\checkpoints\rfdetr-small\old-2-standard-640\info.md
nodes.rationale: Best RF-DETR Small result: 40 epochs, 33.33h, clean augmentation (HorizontalFlip only). TRUSTED test mAP50 89.27% / P 72.71% / R 89.62% / F1 80.10%, closed_eye AP50 92.88%.

nodes.label: RF-DETR Small 384 Worst-Case
nodes.source_file: C:\AI-Based Driver Safety and Assistance System(ADAS)\checkpoints\rfdetr-small\old-3-worstcase-384\info.md
nodes.rationale: Re-scaled from the 640 baseline to 384, halted on plateau at epoch 17; self-reported peak val mAP50 88.67%. Training time is prose-approximate (~8.5h) with no exact seconds recorded, and no independent test evaluation exists.

nodes.label: YOLO11m 384 Worst-Case Fine-Tune
nodes.source_file: C:\AI-Based Driver Safety and Assistance System(ADAS)\checkpoints\yolo11m\old-1-worstcase-384\info.md
nodes.rationale: Warm-started from the 640 trial-2 winner; 40 epochs, AdamW lr0 0.002, 7.68h. imgsz 384 confirmed from its own args.yaml, and cls loss weight 1.2 verified from args.yaml against the 1.5 its own model_summary.txt claims. Test trust LOW: the confusion matrix is byte-identical to reports for architecturally different models, which is impossible for independent evaluations.

nodes.label: YOLO11m 640 Baseline / Trial 2 Winner
nodes.source_file: C:\AI-Based Driver Safety and Assistance System(ADAS)\checkpoints\yolo11m\old-2-trial2winner-640\info.md
nodes.rationale: The old project's self-declared #1 overall winner. No args.yaml survives, so imgsz 640 was recovered by loading its exported best.onnx and reading the input tensor shape [1,3,640,640], and params (20,055,321) by loading best.pt — not assumed from prose. The only SGD run in either project; 53 epochs, patience=10, 26.64h. Test numbers come from info_legacy_archive, a folder with a demonstrated fabrication problem, so they are plausible but unconfirmed.

nodes.label: YOLO11m 640 Worst-Case (D18 Warm-Start Source)
nodes.source_file: C:\AI-Based Driver Safety and Assistance System(ADAS)\checkpoints\yolo11m\old-3-worstcase-d18source-640\info.md
nodes.rationale: The checkpoint this project's D18 cross-dataset warm-start (86.42% real test, this project's best result) was built from. 40 epochs, AdamW lr0 0.001, 40.43h — the single longest run in either project. cls loss 2.0 verified from args.yaml against the 1.5 model_summary.txt claims.
